newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Monday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 2.64 billion yuan from 3.682 billion yuan on Friday and the 60-day contract was the most active.

Traders said the rates fell on reduced volume and wide market expectations that the central bank would shorly cut bank reserve ratios. The bank promised a cut in the short term last July but it has yet to announce the reduction.
"The expectations kept most members from building heavy positions," one trader said.

But the interbank rates will gain some support from the A share markets which have been in a bull run for the past few weeks, traders said. "Securities houses will borrow on the interbank market to trade on the A share markets and this will support the rates," one trader said.
